objects.taxonomy_description: A rigid or semi-rigid rectangular container designed for carrying personal belongings, distinguished by its structural form and travel-specific hardware.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct rectangular prism geometry with defined edges and flat surfaces, unlike soft bags or irregular containers.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Hardware: Visible rigid latches, clasps, or a zipper track run along the perimeter to secure two hinged halves together.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Mobility_Features: The presence of an extendable telescopic handle on one side and wheels at the base distinguishes it from static boxes or hand-held briefcases.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Material: The exterior consists of hard-shell plastic, metal, or reinforced fabric, providing a smooth and uniform texture compared to woven baskets or leather satchels.
